author: SciShow
description:
There isn't a more iconic, powerful oceanic predator than the great white shark. But while researchers have been studying them for decades, they've found that white shark populations are threatened, in two different locations, and for two different reasons. And researchers are still unraveling the mystery to figure out what's going on.

Hosted by: Dr. Imogene Cancellare (she/her)
